becm.description: Battery module, probably the K16 BECM ('BECM-B+EnergyCtrl' in the 09/0A census)

dmcm.description: Drive motor control module 1 (pack voltage and current)

bcm.description: Body control module (battery/coolant temperatures, charge pilot); answers only at priority 0x18

gwm.description: Gateway; answers OBD DTC reads 03/07/0A (used to bracket sessions)

fields.name: soc
fields.label: State of charge
fields.source: S1 (matched the dash on a 2024 Silverado EV), S2, S3; S7
fields.note: 41.88 % read vs 42 % on the dash

fields.name: energy_remaining
fields.label: Energy remaining (BMS)
fields.note: energy_remaining / (soc/100) differs per truck (175-216 kWh seen); label it 'BMS energy at 100%', not usable capacity

fields.name: battery_capability
fields.label: Battery capability
fields.note: S8: 173.86-175.62 kWh next to energy / SoC of about 175, read together with 27AF and 27C6; matches S9's Battery Capability in kind. Compare with Car Scanner on this truck, then mark confirmed

fields.name: pack_capacity_ah
fields.label: Total energy storage capacity
fields.note: Car Scanner's Battery Total Energy Storage Capacity. Replaces the 4676 guess: 4676 is a discharge power limit in S10 and answered FFFF on this truck. Derive shows it only if it fits the pack's voltage. Compare with Car Scanner on this truck, then mark confirmed

fields.name: capacity_deviation
fields.label: Total energy storage capacity deviation
fields.note: Car Scanner's capacity deviation (22 on the owner's screen, S9): the byte after the capacity. Compare with Car Scanner on this truck, then mark confirmed

fields.name: cell_min_b
fields.label: Cell group minimum (modules 13-24)
fields.note: on this truck the 2AF5 summary covers only groups 97-192 (modules 13-24); take the pack min/max from the 2AE1-2AF0 array

fields.name: cell_max_b
fields.label: Cell group maximum (modules 13-24)
fields.note: covers modules 13-24 only on this truck; use the array for the pack max

fields.name: cell_min_index_b
fields.label: Lowest cell group # (97-192)
fields.source: S4 (checked against the full array on an Equinox EV); S7
fields.note: group number 97-192 of the second half; matched the array

fields.name: cell_max_index_b
fields.label: Highest cell group # (97-192)
fields.note: group number within modules 13-24

fields.name: pack_voltages_becm
fields.label: Pack voltages (BECM, 4 sensing points)
fields.source: S2 (4 values on a Sierra EV; meaning of each not yet known); S7

fields.name: module_temps
fields.label: Module temperatures
fields.source: S2 (24 bytes on a Sierra EV), S6; S7
fields.note: 16-17 C on this truck with x-80 while coolant read 19.6-21.6 C; (x-40)/2 would give 28 C. Likely x-80; confirm against outside temp. S10: x-80, and the 24 bytes are two sensors for each of modules 1-12 (battery 1), not one for each of 24 modules

fields.name: module_temps_2
fields.label: Module temperatures, second set
fields.source: S7 (24 bytes, all 0x61 = 17 C with x-80 while 2AF1 read 16-17 C)
fields.note: not in S10. Taken as two sensors for each of modules 13-24 (battery 2), by analogy with 2AF1: an inference

fields.label: 27B9 (Car Scanner reads it; meaning unknown)
